routes.name: Visa-free entry via Belarusian airports
routes.summary: Citizens of 76 listed countries can visit for up to 30 days without a visa if they fly in and out through approved Belarusian airports. No extensions.

other: Passport must be an ordinary one, valid at least 90 days past departure.
Funds of at least 2 base rates per day (50 base rates for 30 days).
Medical insurance of at least EUR 10,000 valid in Belarus for the whole stay.
Not valid for flights arriving from Russia, which count as internal.

Citizens of Egypt, Gambia, Haiti, India, Iran, Jordan, Lebanon, Namibia, Pakistan, Samoa, South Africa and Vietnam also need a multiple-entry EU or Schengen visa with a border stamp, plus a ticket out within 30 days.
The official PDF on the page lists the 76 countries.

stay.note: Counts arrival and departure days. Exit only via Minsk National, Brest, Gomel, Grodno, Mogilev or Vitebsk airport. Register with migration authorities if staying more than 10 working days (hotels usually do this).

sources.label: Belarus MFA: visa-free travel via airports

routes.name: Visa-free entry for citizens of European countries
routes.summary: A temporary visa-free regime for citizens of about 35 European countries, entering by land or air. The official page said it ran until the end of 2025, so check whether it was extended.

other: Page text says validity ran until December 31, 2025. Current status not confirmed.
Polish, Lithuanian and Latvian citizens could stay up to 90 days. Others up to 30 days.
Max 90 visa-free days per calendar year.
Need medical insurance, and car insurance if driving.
Travel to Russia not allowed under this regime.
Work or study needs a Belarusian visa.

stay.note: 90 days for Poland, Lithuania and Latvia. Registration within 10 days (30 for Lithuania and Estonia).

sources.label: Belarus border committee: visa-free entry for European citizens

routes.name: Belarus entry visas (including e-visa and visa on arrival)
routes.summary: Everyone not covered by a visa-free rule needs a visa. The foreign ministry lists visa types, an e-visa and visas issued on arrival at Minsk National Airport. Work, study and long stays need a visa too.

other: Details, fees and durations not confirmed from the official pages. Check the foreign ministry visa section.
Visa-free regimes do not cover work, study or residence.
